summary: Live-update runtime, configuration, delivery, and cutover migration from Ionic Appflow to Capgo.

capabilities.notes: Replace the updater package and synchronize native projects; a new Capgo-enabled native binary is mandatory.
Map automatic and custom update behavior deliberately, including readiness, resume, and forced-update flows.
Create and approve a source-channel to target-channel/native-version compatibility map before delivery.
Retain the CI provider and replace only the bundle delivery step using approved runtime credentials.
Archive source history separately; no historical bundle or analytics import is implied by this skill.
A new native release and normal signing/distribution approval are required, but credentials are never copied by the skill.
